answer: The horizon I would price into every new account is Proof of unique bar exam score report: an exam passed once, on record with the state bar, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that an exam passed once, on record with the state bar — so privacy survives, and the relic is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. Time is the tax here: an exam passed once, on record with the state bar cannot be rushed or parallelised beyond a point, so the beacon for a farm is a calendar it cannot buy its way out of.
